exposure: Obstetricians' attitudes towards cesarean delivery on maternal request
Obstetricians' beliefs about cesarean delivery on maternal request
Hospital measures to decrease cesarean section rates
outcome: Obstetricians' likelihood of performing cesarean delivery on maternal request
finding: Obstetricians who agreed with cesarean delivery on maternal request and believed its benefits outweighed the risks were more likely to perform it, while hospital measures to decrease cesarean sections were associated with a reduced likelihood.
